description: Authoritative trigger-and-owner inventory for every automatic wake-up and direct executor. Phase A preserves all existing ownership; new adapters are read-only.

owners.summary: Automatic issue admission, reservation, WIP accounting, and OpenCode dispatch.
owners.fallback_owner: scheduled issue scheduler pass; a missed event never strands an eligible issue

owners.summary: Recovers lost or failed OpenCode executions for an exact issue/PR HEAD.
state_inputs: issue or PR comments and durable retry markers
owners.fallback_owner: OpenCode watchdog workflow_run wakeup and durable lifecycle markers

owners.summary: Marks an exact-HEAD PR ready for the configured optional review provider and wakes the merge controller.
owners.fallback_owner: mark-ready-for-coderabbit workflow_run wakeup plus the auto-merge scheduled safety net

owners.summary: Dispatches conflict repair and CI repair for an open PR without duplicating an active repair.
state_inputs: durable repair markers and retry evidence
owners.fallback_owner: OpenCode repair controller workflow_run/pull_request_target wakeups; scheduled auto-merge reconciliation

owners.summary: Serializes the shared CodeRabbit review quota and requests the next legal full review.
owners.fallback_owner: CodeRabbit controller schedule 3,13,23,33,43,53 * * * *

owners.summary: Batches unresolved CodeRabbit findings and dispatches one canonical OpenCode repair.
state_inputs: verification markers bound to the exact HEAD
owners.fallback_owner: canonical CodeRabbit unresolved caller wakeup; no cron by design

owners.summary: Admits and runs the configured PR-Agent review for one exact open non-draft HEAD.
owners.fallback_owner: PR-Agent recovery schedule */10 * * * * and workflow_run wakeups

owners.summary: Recovers missing, stale, or transiently failed PR-Agent review/repair operations.
owners.fallback_owner: PR-Agent recovery schedule */10 * * * *

owners.summary: Evaluates the provider-neutral exact-HEAD merge gates and merges atomically or waits.
state_inputs: current-HEAD CI, Contract Gate, qualification and packaging runs
owners.fallback_owner: auto-merge schedule 17,47 * * * * and successful-CI workflow_run wakeup

owners.summary: Provider-neutral CodeRabbit/common merge controller; review policy stays in the CodeRabbit adapter.
owners.fallback_owner: auto-merge schedule 17,47 * * * *

owners.summary: Discovers Continuum consumers and wakes only their existing repository-local reconcilers.
owners.fallback_owner: schedule 17,47 * * * * and workflow_dispatch only

owners.summary: Dispatches, retries, and evaluates mandatory post-merge qualification and contract qualification.
owners.fallback_owner: scheduled issue scheduler for capability qualification; contract qualification schedule 23 5 * * *

owners.summary: Parent/Child delegated scheduling, worker execution, review, and run cleanup with opaque child ids.
owners.fallback_owner: parent issue-scheduler schedule 7,17,27,37,47,57 * * * *

owners.summary: Executes owner commands and scheduled/synthetic issue or PR work; never owns admission policy.
state_inputs: owner command or scheduler dispatch marker
owners.fallback_owner: manual owner /oc command or scheduler dispatch; no autonomous direct trigger

owners.summary: Runs PR-Agent repair for structured findings; does not duplicate review or merge policy.
owners.fallback_owner: PR-Agent recovery schedule */10 * * * *

owners.summary: Manual PR-Agent canary using the OpenCode backend.
owners.fallback_owner: workflow_dispatch only

owners.summary: Executes and recovers Render deployments without GitHub-token fallback credentials.
owners.fallback_owner: manual/workflow dispatch only; no new scheduler

owners.summary: Repository contract tests, actionlint, and reusable validation entrypoint.
owners.fallback_owner: push/pull_request project CI and pull_request Contract Gate

owners.summary: Contract Gate and scheduled contract qualification for the Continuum control plane.
state_inputs: contract workflow evidence on exact HEAD
owners.fallback_owner: Contract qualification schedule 23 5 * * *

owners.summary: Publishes the repository runtime secret public key; not an issue/PR lifecycle owner.
owners.fallback_owner: workflow_dispatch

owners.summary: Opt-in Swift CI technology library; Continuum never triggers it itself.
owners.fallback_owner: consumer-owned push/pull_request/manual dispatch only

owners.summary: Project-owned live model-routing end-to-end verification.
owners.fallback_owner: workflow_dispatch
